findings.detail: Host-backed ui-chat settings independently store transcriptView (compact/standard/detailed/verbose), collapseTiming (completion/next-input) and foldedReplies (all/final). The default keeps all replies; legacy normal/expanded detail values remain accepted.

Final-only controls visibility inside a completed native Turn process. It does not remove messages from history/model input. Verbose mode does not fold; open/stopped/interrupted/error Turns stay open. Interleaved input also disables whole-Turn folding; partial history can become eligible from a loaded end without its start.

AgentMessage exposes id/role/createdAt/completedAt/parts, without native Turn/Step/seq membership. harness_snapshot::assistant_message forwards only the nested message and time; turn/start/end update global status/error instead of retaining per-Turn presentation metadata. AgentTranscript groups text and activity boundaries without a native Turn-process projection.

A final-only checkbox that filters to the last assistant text between visible user messages would lose native boundaries for background or Goal continuations, interleaved steering, interrupted Turns and partial history. The flattened message contract alone cannot establish upstream-equivalent final-answer selection.

nextImplementation: Project authoritative native Turn/Step/seq, final answer boundary and per-Turn lifecycle/reason into a compatible view sidecar for both live frames and read-only history replay; preserve old message IDs and user data.
Reuse upstream public presentation/Turn-process contracts where possible, with independent durable preferences and proper legacy/default handling. Keep all replies as the default.

Apply final-only to a completed process disclosure; expanding restores intermediate replies. Keep active/failed/interrupted and interleaved-input processes visible; preserve tool/error/question/automation surfaces.
